_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Wɔre yɛ Klondike Solitaire. Wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛfa nkrataa nyinaa kɔ foundation no mu.

Mmara:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Sɛ wɔbɛsi nkrataa no wɔ suit no mu
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Sɛ wɔbɛsi nkrataa no wɔ kɔla a ɛteɛ (kɔkɔɔ wɔ tuntum, tuntum wɔ kɔkɔɔ)
- Stock: Fa nkrataa fi stock kɔ waste
- Waste (W): Nkrataa a ɛwɔ waste no mu a wɔbɛtumi de yɛ adwuma

Nkrataa:
- 'draw' - Fa nkrataa fi stock kɔ waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Fa nkrataa fi pile baako kɔ pile foforo
  Nhɛma: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count nso betumi ayɛ 'all', a wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wɔfa nkrataa nyinaa.
- 'forfeit' - Bɔ mmɔdenbɔ no akyi na wɔnkye wɔn score
- Pile din: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Wɔbetumi yɛ adwuma pii wɔ krataa baako mu a wɔahyɛ mu nkutoo:
  Nhɛma: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Nkrataa a ɛteɛ no na wɔbɛtumi de kɔ tableau no mu.
Adwuma no yɛ wɔ nkrataa mu - sɛ wɔbɔ mmɔdenbɔ no akyi a, adwuma a aka no wɔnkye.
De 'forfeit' sɛ wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɔ mmɔdenbɔ no akyi.
